lines.text: PEACE perfect peace to Cherub
and Seraph
Establish'd for Christ's exultation here.
Peace Perfect peace to all the
true members
Of universal Cherub, Seraphim.
Peace perfect peace to all with
faith in Christ
Bear His witness till death their
lives demand.
Peace perfect peace to all with
faith in Christ
Bear poverty tlnroughout their
days on earth.
Peace perfect peace to all with faith
in Christ
Who like Christ work bothered not
by mock'ry.
Peace perfect peace to all with faith
in Christ
Receive Christ seal amidst elect on earth.
Peace perfect peace to members
of this Band
The Crown of glory our reward shall be.
The Band is full and daily multiply
By grace of Christ will go right round the World.
Great power of Christ exists in the Band
Can not be moved by any wave of life.
Let He who sought the downfall
of this band
Be made to know it's hard to kick
the thorns.
When the world and its glory pass away
The Band for ever with the Lord shall reign.
Shout Halleluyah to the glorious King
For Sacred Cherub and Seraphim Band.
Amen.
